answer: Tie each identity to a non-transferable stake anchor, then every few minutes a public randomness beacon emits a fresh cipher challenge each agent must decrypt live with its anchor-bound key and answer inside a tight window. A gale of sybil clones must each hold a distinct anchor AND stay awake to catch its own probe; one missed beacon slashes that identity bond. Honest agents pay the anchor cost once; a fake farm pays it per head and forfeits bonds on every missed cipher, so cost scales linearly with the swarm while yield stays flat.
